name: AIMAX Berhad
overview: 2026年，公司由 HONG SENG CONSOLIDATED BERHAD 更名为 AIMAX BERHAD，并有多项财务援助公告，但公告未披露具体业务板块变化。
overview_en: In 2026, the company changed its name from HONG SENG CONSOLIDATED BERHAD to AIMAX BERHAD and made several announcements on provision of financial assistance, but the announcements did not disclose specific changes in business segments.
